audit.why: Even lane 1-5 (immobile Taric, no Bastion stacks yet), swings to Taric at 6 (Cosmic Radiance) through late game once he has tank items and Bastion-linked E stun.

Zilean's level-2 double-bomb (Q-rewind-Q via W cooldown reduction) is the early spike; Taric's spikes are level 6 (Cosmic Radiance, 180/150/120s) and first tank item (Bastion shield tempo + E stun at 16-12s).

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreement: full-layer phases[0-2].side say 'Zilean' and phases[4].side says 'Skill', but content win[0-3] already say 'Skill' and win[4] says 'Taric'. The two layers render different answers for who wins levels 1-3 and level 6.
audit.why: Content whys already correctly describe an even skill lane through level 5 (Taric immobile, no Bastion stacks, shield-heal roughly cancels poke) that swings to Taric at 6 when Cosmic Radiance's delayed invulnerability blanks the double-bomb all-in. The full-layer sides and whys were never updated to match.
audit.corrected: Move phases[0/1/2].side to 'Skill' and phases[4].side to 'Taric', rewriting each .why to match the content-layer reasoning (no content edits needed since win[] is already correct).

edits.before: Q-bomb the contacts — the sticky chip annoys and the double-bomb threat governs.
edits.after: Both immobile at level 1 — no dashes either side, so bomb-contact trades stay skill-even.

edits.before: W loops begin: the rewind means your cooldowns lie; theirs don't.
edits.after: Level-2 double-bomb burst meets his shield-heal stabilization — the trades roughly cancel, still skill-even.

edits.before: Double-bomb stun live: Q-W-Q is the lane's longest-range stun setup.
edits.after: Double-bomb stun is live, but his Starlight's Touch sustain matches your poke — skill-decided, not a lane lead.

edits.before: Chronoshift online — their kill math now includes an undo button.
edits.after: Cosmic Radiance's delayed invulnerability blanks your double-bomb all-in outright, swinging level 6 to Taric.

edits.before: Q the carry, W, Q the stun, walk — the double-bomb chunk that started as chip.
edits.after: Land Q on him before he closes — a stacked second Q turns chip into a real stun.

edits.before: Spending the R on a survivable catch — the undo insures deaths, not discomfort.
edits.after: Chronoshift is for lethal hits only — burn it on chip and it's down for the real all-in.

edits.before: - Taric Cosmic Radiance: matchup-defining — The delayed invulnerability erases your teamfight damage — burst before it lands or wait it out. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E Time Warp answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Taric R Cosmic Radiance (180/150/120s): matchup-defining — the delayed invulnerability erases your teamfight damage; burst before it lands or wait it out. - His E Dazzle recharges in 16-12s as he ranks it — punish that window. - Spend your R on swing moments only.
